Asset type: one alternative Observable Universe icon for a scientific size-and-mass chart, transparent PNG.

Primary request: A perfectly spherical translucent marble whose OUTER SHELL carries a subtle mottled cosmic microwave background pattern, with a three-dimensional cosmic web of supercluster filaments visible INSIDE the sphere. Artistic conceptual miniature, not a literal observational reconstruction.

Interior very deep midnight indigo with warm ivory/gold filaments and restrained cool blue strands. Balanced: both CMB shell and cosmic web should be recognizable; neither obscures the other. Gentle refraction and rim shading convey substantial spherical volume.
Lighting: collection's soft key light from upper left; believable shaded sphere, subtle contained internal light, no huge flares, no external aura. Sophisticated realistic 3D illustration with fine detail, not cartoon.
Constraints: real transparent alpha outside sphere, no opaque background rectangle, no wall, no stars outside silhouette, no cast shadow, no separate objects, no labels, text, diagram arrows or watermark. No cutaway wedge or sliced sphere. No cubic volumes.
